blocks.raw: ## API Reference: Domain ownership validation challenges
blocks.text: API Reference: Domain ownership validation challenges

blocks.raw: - [Generate challenges to verify domain ownership](https://techdocs.akamai.com/property-mgr/reference/post-domain-ownership-challenges.md): Confirm you own all the domains for property hostnames you configure. This keeps your domains safe and prevents other customers from using them to serve traffic over the Akamai edge network. You need to complete this validation before activating your property.
